failure_modes: The cash engine fell 100% from its 2017-09-24 peak to its 2023-09-24 trough and went negative and has not come back — the price recovering is optional, owner earnings recovering is not.

The cash engine buckled when the world tilted: the 2020 demand shock took owner earnings 39% below the prior peak (2020-09-27) and it has not come back; the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 109% below the prior peak (2022-09-25) and it has not come back.

This business resists valuation: annual revenue growth is typically 2 points away from its -5%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 13 points away from its 7% average — what cannot be valued must be avoided however cheap it looks.
